rows.name: Kimi
rows.label: hype
rows.verdict: Moonshot AI's assistant, now running Kimi K3.1 Pro (released Oct 23, 2026): a 2.8T-parameter open-weight MoE with a 1M-token context, strong at long coding sessions, agent tasks and 3D/Blender work at a low cost per task. Use it free in the Kimi web/app or via Kimi Code and the API. ~11k X posts in a week; claims of matching top US models still need independent checks.
